description: Exact W2 forward references from shipped methodology files to W4 inventory rows and playbooks that are not installed yet. Every tuple must match an actual reference, its target must be absent, and its owningWave must match docs/skill-inventory.json (skills) or the W4 playbook reconciliation (nested playbooks). Retire a tuple when its target ships; the W3 tuples retired when W3 shipped. All tuples retired at the W4 reconcile, when every inventory row and playbook shipped; the W4 gate chose no W5 deferrals, so this list is empty.
